summary: URGENT diagnosis request: confirmed FALSE ALARM. Web preview (localhost:3000) loads correctly, passes the native boot splash (app-boot-splash testID) within ~1-2 seconds, and renders the full app flow normally. Tested full journey: boot splash -> country selection ('Wybierz swój kraj') -> landing/auth screen -> login as admin -> main app (Zawody tab) -> dismiss AI-cost info modal -> Profil tab. No red screen, no console errors/warnings, no failed network requests at any step. All backend API calls returned 200 (auth/login, account/country, auth/me, recommendations).
action_items: No fix required for the boot splash / preview issue — confirmed false alarm, likely caused by the internal screenshot tool taking a snapshot too early (before fonts/theme finished loading) or a transient Metro rebundle delay, not an actual app bug.

The pre-existing ENOENT errors for 'expo-router/assets/fonts' and 'frontend/fonts' in expo.err.log are unrelated to this flow (already previously diagnosed) and did not block loading in this test run.
Optional improvement (not urgent): consider reducing AppBootSplash dependency on font loading timeout, or add a max-wait fallback, purely as defensive hardening — not because a bug was observed.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx AppBootSplash logic is sound: it waits on (fontsLoaded || fontError) && themeReady before rendering the Stack, with proper .catch() guards around preventAutoHideAsync/hideAsync so web rejections can't hang the app. No changes recommended.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (boot -> onboarding -> auth -> login -> tab navigation all working)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview/boot-splash issue is NOT reproducible via Playwright with normal wait times (tested up to 15s, app transitions well before that, usually <2s). If the user reports it again, check whether their own screenshot tool/browser session has stale cache, or whether it happens on a specific device/browser the internal tool emulates differently from real browsers.
rca_of_issue: No bug found. Reproduction steps used: navigate to localhost:3000 with 375x667 viewport, wait 3s/8s/15s checking app-boot-splash visibility (all False, meaning splash already dismissed) and screenshot each time — app consistently showed the post-boot country selection / landing screen, never stuck. Login flow (konto.administratora@wp.pl / admin2026!) and tab navigation (Zawody -> Profil) also worked without errors, confirming this was a tooling/timing artifact as suspected by main agent, not an actual regression.
